description: Configure language-specific formatters for a multi-language workspace. The workspace at /home/ga/workspace/polyglot_project contains Python (main.py), JavaScript (app.js), and JSON (config.json) files that need proper formatting. Configure VSCode settings to use the correct formatter for each language: (1) For Python files, set editor.defaultFormatter to 'ms-python.black-formatter' or 'ms-python.python' in the [python] language-specific settings section. (2) For JavaScript files, set editor.defaultFormatter to 'esbenp.prettier-vscode' in the [javascript] section. (3) For JSON files, set editor.defaultFormatter to 'esbenp.prettier-vscode' in the [json] section. You can configure this by opening Settings (Ctrl+Shift+P → 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)') and adding language-specific configuration blocks. Settings can be in workspace .vscode/settings.json or user settings at /home/ga/.config/Code/User/settings.json. Ensure the JSON syntax is valid.
